interpretation.primary: Dataset-balanced macro relative E gain and paired sparse-minus-dense interaction; report all six cells and both seeds.
interpretation.conditional_followup_signal: Sparse macro gain > 0; mean sparse-minus-dense gain > 0; interaction positive for at least two of three sources. Descriptive prioritization only, not statistical significance or publication PASS.
interpretation.uncertainty: 2000 resamples of four chronological 8-origin blocks, paired across arms, channels and seeds. Budgets share E. Descriptive only.
interpretation.policy_baseline: Choose plain or anchor by V only, exact ties favor plain. Additional arm-selection budget is disclosed.
interpretation.window_budget_limitation: Common train-only scales and overlapping context exposure: not a strict label-scarcity intervention.
